summary: Milestone B5 — Mobile Event Creation. Backend + Frontend end-to-end tested. ALL P0 items (1–18) PASS. Backend pytest suite: 7/7 passing (member+admin bearer tokens both accepted on /api/mcgs/george/event/*, warm opener returned with field_being_asked='idea' when text is empty, multi-turn extraction lands drafted+correct confirmation copy, member approve→outcome=submitted_for_review+routed_to=events_pending_approval+target.sources present, admin approve→outcome=published, editing-out-of-scope politely deferred, cancel session works). Frontend UI Playwright run through end-to-end at http://localhost:3000 with viewport 375x812: sign-in as Alex → home shows resting butterfly + returning greeting bubble 'Hi Alex. I'm around if you need me — no rush.' → tap butterfly opens slide-up chat with header 'George' + butterfly mark + 'Save for later' link → opener renders exactly 'I'd love to help with that.' (excitement, teal) followed by 'Tell me about the kind of get-together you're hoping to create.' → placeholder reads 'Tell George about your idea…' → George replied warmly with excitement+working line+ONE open question after the seed idea → after title turn the Action Preview card renders with header 'Here's what I've put together' + subheader 'Have I captured it properly?' + all 8 rows (GET-TOGETHER / DATE / TIME / WHERE / ROOM FOR / COST / FOR / ABOUT IT) with inferred rows tagged '(George pencilled this in)' → three buttons render exactly as spec: 'That looks right' (primary teal) / 'Let's change something' (secondary, curly apostrophe U+2019) / 'Save for later' (tertiary) → tapping 'That looks right' as Alex (no publish_events) shows the celebration surface with 'Off to the FriendPlace team.' + full body copy + primary button 'Wonderful — thank you, George' → 'Save for later' link in header closes modal and butterfly is resting on home. Router (P0 17-18): with profile_complete=true and has_active_onboarding=false the tap opens event creation (verified). Flipped Alex to profile_complete=false + reopened onboarding session; tap now opens the ONBOARDING surface ('I'm so glad you're up for this! Let's start with something easy…') instead of event creation. Restored Alex to profile_complete=true afterwards. No P0/P1 regressions. Zero red-screen errors, zero page errors. Only pre-existing console warnings (shadow*/textShadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver missing on web, props.pointerEvents deprecated) — all inherited from prior iterations, not B5-specific.

issues: Testability: no testID props on any of the B5 surfaces (GeorgeButterfly.tsx, GeorgeEventCreation.tsx, GeorgeEventCelebration.tsx). All Playwright selectors had to fall back to visible text or the single aria-label='Talk to George' on the butterfly. Recommend adding testIDs on the composer input, Send button, the three preview buttons (That looks right / Let's change something / Save for later), and the celebration primary button (Wonderful — thank you, George) so future regression runs stay reliable.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses `pointerEvents="box-none"` as a prop on Animated.View — React Native web logs 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/george/GeorgeButterfly.tsx:266. Cosmetic on web; will surface as a soft deprecation on native too. Migrate to style.pointerEvents.

shadow* and textShadow* style props are deprecated in favour of boxShadow / textShadow. These are already fired by other admin surfaces and are not new in B5, but the same StyleSheet.create() blocks in GeorgeEventCreation.tsx / GeorgeEventCelebration.tsx use `shadowColor`/`shadowOpacity`/`shadowRadius`. Not user-visible, but should be swept before next milestone.

'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' — always-on warning under Expo web preview. Falls back to JS animation. Fine for web preview; on device it will use the native driver. No action required, noted for context.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testID props to key B5 elements — composer input ('event-composer'), Send button ('event-send'), preview buttons ('preview-approve' / 'preview-change' / 'preview-save-for-later'), celebration primary button ('celebration-thank-you'), and the header 'Save for later' link ('event-save-for-later-header'). Would let regression Playwright runs bypass fragile text selectors as George's Sonnet copy drifts.
OPTIONAL: Migrate `pointerEvents="box-none"` prop → `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` in GeorgeButterfly.tsx line 266 to silence the RN-web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL: Sweep StyleSheet.create() blocks that use shadow*/textShadow* to boxShadow/textShadow — non-blocking, cosmetic warning.

OPTIONAL: The preview card renders 'For: members' with no '(George pencilled this in)' tag on Alex's test run — spec lists 'FOR' as a row but is silent on whether it should be tagged when defaulted. If defaulted, it should carry the same pencilled tag as other inferred rows for consistency. Confirm intent with product.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/mcgs_module.py lines 491-517: /event/start correctly accepts empty text (validates spec point 'empty text accepted') and derives actor_role from the bearer token via current_george_actor rather than trusting the body. Good.

backend/mcgs_module.py lines 528, 547, 560, 579: every event endpoint scopes actor via `session.get('actor_id') != actor.get('id')` → 403. This means an admin cannot approve a member's draft, which is spec-correct (Alex's approvals are hers; admin approvals go through the admin's own session with publish_events). Confirmed empirically by the passing admin approve test.

backend/services/george/event_creation/service.py: session shape uses `turns` with role in {'user','george'} plus optional `excitement_line`/`working_line`/`state` per George turn — matches the two-model composer contract. `sources` lives on `draft.sources` (not top-level). Testers should look for it there.

frontend/src/components/george/GeorgeEventCreation.tsx line 203: button reads `Let’s change something` — JSX entity renders as U+2019 curly apostrophe. Matches the spec text (which uses a straight ASCII apostrophe). Not a bug — the typography is cleaner — but selectors must match the curly variant.

frontend/src/components/george/GeorgeButterfly.tsx lines 207-221: tap→presence-refresh→branch-to-event-or-onboarding is exactly the router contract. Falls back to onboarding on presence error (safe default). Router test confirmed live.

frontend/src/components/george/GeorgeButterfly.tsx line 260: `canTap = phase === 'resting' || phase === 'landed'` — the fix from iteration_71/72 is landed here too on the mobile side, so users can tap the butterfly during the returning-greeting bubble window without silent failure.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_b5_event_creation.py (new — 7 pytest cases covering P0 backend items 1–6 + presence flags)

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 pytest — start opener, multi-turn draft, member approve→submitted_for_review, admin approve→published, edit-out-of-scope deferred, cancel flow, presence flags)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on P0 UI items 7–16 (butterfly tap, header, opener copy, placeholder, warm reply to seed, action preview card + all 8 rows + pencilled tags, three preview buttons with correct labels, That-looks-right→celebration path with Off-to-the-FriendPlace-team + Wonderful-thank-you-George, Save-for-later closes modal cleanly). Router P0 17–18 both verified.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily flipped Alex (member@friendplace.com.au) to profile_complete=false + reopened one onboarding conversation to verify router P0 18. Restored to profile_complete=true and marked reopened onboarding session status='completed' at end of run. Test-created data: 4 rows in events_pending_approval (from member 'That looks right' taps + backend pytest submitted_for_review case) and 2 rows in events prefixed 'TEST_admin_b5' (from backend admin publish test). All test rows are prefixed or attributable to the test session ids for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Backend endpoint shape: session.turns is a list of {role, content, at, excitement_line?, working_line?, state?} — role is 'user' or 'george' (NOT 'assistant'). To pull George's latest text include excitement_line + working_line + content. 2) Approve response shape: {session_id, routed_to: 'events_pending_approval'|'events', outcome: 'submitted_for_review'|'published', target: {...event_row incl. sources array}}. 3) Admin login: POST /api/cms/auth/login with {email, password} returns {ok, token, admin} — the field is `token`, not `access_token`. Bearer both work on the shared /api/mcgs/* routes because current_george_actor auto-detects. 4) Frontend: no testIDs anywhere on the George B5 surfaces. Butterfly's aria-label is 'Talk to George' (matches the spec fix note from iteration_71, though the old label included ' — tap to open' on web bridge, that's admin surface, mobile is just 'Talk to George'). 5) The three preview buttons render curly apostrophes — search for 'change something' substring rather than the full 'Let's change something' literal. 6) Alex's rewind flow: `db.users.updateOne({email:'member@friendplace.com.au'},{$set:{profile_complete:false}})` + reopen an onboarding row via update_many({actor_id:'d8ef0bc1-1dfe-44d8-aa8b-46a0ad68e0ba'},{$set:{status:'in_progress'}}) — restore with profile_complete:true + close onboarding rows to 'completed' after the router test.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. Milestone B5 is implementation-complete and matches spec on every P0 item observed. The only remaining friction is testability (no testIDs) and cosmetic RN-web deprecation warnings inherited from earlier work.
